svg.text: the Jodel - a 12 m/s taxi into a 35 cm stump, on the runway (paved): the scar from above, before (DMG-SCAR) and after (DMG-SCAR2)

pale: the grass culled (the craters' discs, the gouges' strips, the resting wreck's hulls + margin); the decal as laid (its own triangles: the soil map x its colours at their alpha); dashed discs: craters; brown lines: gouges' paths (black: the prop's slot);

red: the scar's hulls; blue dashed: the wreck as it lies at the run's end (the gate's own reader: each piece's nodes within 1.2 m of the ground); grey dots: the ground contacts the gate saw. The sweep (shrubs only) is not drawn.
